info.title: Caesura API
info.description:
The public REST API. Every endpoint takes an account API token as
`Authorization: Bearer tc_...`, minted in Account settings.

Scopes:
- `trips:read` — See your trips, their days and stops, costs, history, and existing share links.
- `trips:write` — Create, change and delete trips, days and stops; undo, redo and revert.
- `notebook:read` — Read the Notebook pages on a trip.
- `notebook:write` — Create, change and delete the Notebook pages on a trip.
- `library:read` — Read your saved-days library.
- `library:write` — Create and delete saved days, and publish or unpublish them to Discover.
- `sharing:write` — Invite people to a trip, revoke invites, remove members, and create or revoke share links.
- `account:read` — See who you are and what plan you hold.

post.summary: Apply a Playbook's days and stops to a trip, appended or merged, as one undoable change
post.description: Requires the `trips:write` scope. Requires at least the `editor` role on the trip.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the first answer instead of running again; the same key with a different request is a 400, and one still in progress is a 409. Kept for 24 hours, per account. A 5xx is not kept.

version.description: Apply only if the Playbook is still at this `version`; otherwise 409 with `details.currentVersion`.

dayId.description: A day already in the trip. The Playbook's day 0 goes onto it, day 1 onto the next, and so on.

placement.description: `append` (the default) adds every Playbook day at the end of the trip. `startingAt` merges: Playbook day k goes onto the trip day k places after `dayId`, and only the days that run past the end of the trip are added.

expectedTripSeq.description: Apply only if the trip still stands at this revision (the `historySeq` a previous write answered, or the newest history entry's `toSeq`); otherwise 409 with `details.currentSeq`. Checked in the same transaction as the write.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` when this answer is a replay of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

dayIds.description: Per Playbook day, in order, the trip day it landed on — new days on an append; existing days, then any new ones, on a `startingAt` merge. Empty days included.

createdDayIds.description: Only the days this application added, in order. Equal to `dayIds` on an append.

activityIds.description: The new stops' ids, in the same order as the Playbook's `stops`.

historySeq.description: The revision the trip stands at after this application (its history entry's `toSeq`). The whole application is that one entry, so one undo removes all of it.

warnings.description: Advice, never a refusal: nothing is dropped because of one. `conflict` is a conflict this application introduced that involves a new stop; `weekday-mismatch` is a stop anchored to weekdays that landed on a dated day that is none of them.

4XX.description: One envelope for every failure: `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`. 401 carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`; 429 carries `Retry-After`.
